# package server

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-bacnet/server"
```

Package server is a BACnet/IP server: it serves one Device (package server/object) on one BACnet/IP endpoint.

One receive loop parses every frame. Confirmed and unconfirmed requests are executed by a bounded pool of workers; the receive loop itself only answers what needs no handler (Reject, Abort, repeated requests) and drives segmentation. COV and event notifications are sent by the server's own requester, with retries for confirmed ones.

The server is silent unless WithLogger or WithDiagnosticFunc is given, keeps no package-level state, and Close waits for every goroutine it started.

## Types

### type BBMD

```go
type BBMD interface {
	// HandleBVLC processes one inbound BVLC message that is not a plain
	// Original-Unicast-NPDU. It returns deliver true when the NPDU it carries
	// must also be processed by the local device, with the address of the
	// node that originated it.
	HandleBVLC(ctx context.Context, msg bvlc.Message, from bip.Endpoint, send func(context.Context, bip.OutboundPacket) error) (deliver bool, origin bip.Endpoint)
	// LocalBroadcast is called when the local device sends a local
	// broadcast, so that the BBMD forwards it to its peers and foreign
	// devices (Annex J.4.5).
	LocalBroadcast(ctx context.Context, npdu []byte, send func(context.Context, bip.OutboundPacket) error)
}
```

BBMD is a BACnet/IP broadcast management device that shares the server's endpoint (package bbmd implements it).

### type Hooks

```go
type Hooks struct {
	// BeforeWrite is called before a WriteProperty, each write of a
	// WritePropertyMultiple, or an AddListElement or RemoveListElement (the
	// Write then holds the elements as a constructed value) is applied. A
	// returned error is sent as the answer (see object.Err). Default: allow.
	BeforeWrite func(ctx context.Context, obj bacnet.ObjectIdentifier, w object.Write) error
	// BeforeDelete is called before DeleteObject removes a deletable
	// object. Default: allow.
	BeforeDelete func(ctx context.Context, obj bacnet.ObjectIdentifier) error
	// Reinitialize is called for ReinitializeDevice after the password was
	// checked; the SimpleACK is sent when it returns nil. Default: accept
	// and do nothing.
	Reinitialize func(ctx context.Context, state service.ReinitializedStateOfDevice) error
	// TimeSync is called for TimeSynchronization (utc false) and
	// UTCTimeSynchronization (utc true).
	//
	// The services below act only through their hook: without it they are
	// not listed in Protocol_Services_Supported, a confirmed request is
	// rejected with unrecognized-service and an unconfirmed one ignored.
	TimeSync func(t service.TimeSynchronization, utc bool)
	// PrivateTransfer handles Confirmed/UnconfirmedPrivateTransfer. For a
	// confirmed one the returned elements are the resultBlock.
	PrivateTransfer func(ctx context.Context, p service.PrivateTransfer, confirmed bool) ([]bacnet.Element, error)
	// TextMessage handles Confirmed/UnconfirmedTextMessage.
	TextMessage func(ctx context.Context, m service.TextMessage, confirmed bool) error
	// WriteGroup handles WriteGroup.
	WriteGroup func(ctx context.Context, w service.WriteGroup)
}
```

Hooks are the application's part in services that act on the device rather than on an object. Each runs on a worker with the request's deadline; a nil hook keeps the default given per field.

### type Option

```go
type Option func(*config)
```

Option configures a Server.

#### func WithBBMD

```go
func WithBBMD(b BBMD) Option
```

WithBBMD makes the server also act as a BBMD.

#### func WithCOVLimits

```go
func WithCOVLimits(maxSubscriptions int, maxLifetime time.Duration) Option
```

WithCOVLimits bounds COV subscriptions (default 256) and their lifetime (0: no limit, which also admits indefinite subscriptions).

#### func WithDecodeLimits

```go
func WithDecodeLimits(l bacnet.DecodeLimits) Option
```

WithDecodeLimits sets the decode limits for inbound frames. The default is bacnet.DefaultDecodeLimits with MaxAPDUSize raised to MaxDatagramSize, so an APDU longer than Max\_APDU\_Length\_Accepted is still served; set MaxAPDUSize to drop such frames.

#### func WithDiagnosticFunc

```go
func WithDiagnosticFunc(fn func(Diagnostic)) Option
```

WithDiagnosticFunc receives every diagnostic. It runs on the receive loop or a worker and must not block.

#### func WithHooks

```go
func WithHooks(h Hooks) Option
```

WithHooks installs application hooks.

#### func WithInterface

```go
func WithInterface(name string) Option
```

WithInterface limits broadcasts (I-Am, I-Have) to one interface.

#### func WithLocalAddr

```go
func WithLocalAddr(addr string) Option
```

WithLocalAddr binds the UDP socket to host:port.

#### func WithLogger

```go
func WithLogger(l *slog.Logger) Option
```

WithLogger logs diagnostics. The server is silent without it.

#### func WithMaxAPDU

```go
func WithMaxAPDU(size uint16) Option
```

WithMaxAPDU sets Max\_APDU\_Length\_Accepted (50..1476, default 1476).

#### func WithPassword

```go
func WithPassword(p string) Option
```

WithPassword sets the password that DeviceCommunicationControl and ReinitializeDevice must carry (at most 20 characters). Without it no password is checked.

#### func WithPort

```go
func WithPort(port int) Option
```

WithPort sets the UDP port (default 47808).

#### func WithSegmentation

```go
func WithSegmentation(maxSegments int, window uint8) Option
```

WithSegmentation sets segmentation support: maxSegments (2..255; 0 disables segmentation) and the proposed window size (1..127).

#### func WithTransactionOptions

```go
func WithTransactionOptions(apduTimeout time.Duration, retries int, segmentTimeout time.Duration) Option
```

WithTransactionOptions sets APDU timeout, retries and segment timeout for the server's own confirmed requests (notifications) and segmented replies; they are also the values of the Device's APDU properties.

#### func WithTransport

```go
func WithTransport(t bip.Transport) Option
```

WithTransport serves on t instead of opening a UDP socket. Close closes t.

#### func WithWorkers

```go
func WithWorkers(workers, queue int) Option
```

WithWorkers sets the number of request workers (default 4) and the number of requests that may wait for one (default 64). A confirmed request that finds the queue full is answered with Abort (out-of-resources); an unconfirmed one is dropped.

### type Server

type Server struct {

Server serves one Device.

#### func New

```go
func New(dev *object.Device, opts ...Option) (*Server, error)
```

New starts a server for dev. It opens a UDP socket unless WithTransport is given, and starts the receive loop and the workers.

#### func (Server) Close

```go
func (s *Server) Close() error
```

Close stops the server: it stops receiving, ends in-flight transactions and subscriptions, waits for every goroutine and closes the transport. Close is idempotent.

#### func (Server) Device

```go
func (s *Server) Device() *object.Device
```

Device returns the served Device.

#### func (Server) IAm

```go
func (s *Server) IAm() error
```

IAm broadcasts an I-Am for the device (at start-up, for example). It is not sent while DeviceCommunicationControl disables initiation.

#### func (Server) Local

```go
func (s *Server) Local() bip.Endpoint
```

Local returns the local BACnet/IP endpoint.
